questions.stem_text: What happens to neurotransmitters once they have "done their job?"

options.A: Neurotransmitters diffuse away and are exhaled
options.B: Neurotransmitters are converted into cellular energy
options.C: Neurotransmitters replicate to enhance the initial signal
options.E: Neurotransmitters are released into the bloodstream

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Neurotransmitters diffuse away and are exhaled

questions.stem_text: Abraham Maslow's hierarachy of needs theorizes that each person is motivated by what?

options.B: striving for self-actualization and personal growth
options.E: desire for power and dominance over others

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - solely by their physical needs
